purpose: Make blind/independent source exposure auditable at the exact winning-claim or lane scope without adding a routine GitHub write or weakening ordinary research execution.
source_pin_rule: Every same-repository mathematical source named by the blind lifecycle is pinned by exact repository-relative path + 40-hex commit + Git blob SHA-1. Branch names, moving main, path-only references, and caller-asserted blob identities are not source authority.
execution_scope_rule: Every firewall record binds the current immutable publication and the current authorized winning CLAIM. For cohort work it also binds execution_cohort_id + execution_lane_id. Sibling lanes therefore have independent blind provenance.

artifact_identity: Git blob SHA-1 computed from exact bytes
raw_freeze.later_correction: append/freeze a later result; never rewrite the frozen raw artifact or raw-freeze record

source_exposure.precondition: PRE_MATH valid and RAW_FREEZE exact bytes still match their frozen identities

remote_publication_policy.reason: The firewall is a local evidence boundary and can be batched with the first genuine durable checkpoint. Blind execution must not acquire a generic pre-math GitHub push tax.
remote_publication_policy.task_specific_override: source_firewall.remote_stamp_before_math_required=true remains fail-closed until an external orchestrator supplies independently verified remote publication evidence. A caller boolean cannot satisfy this override.

downstream_composition.after_source_exposure: reference/audit work may consume the now-exposed source set
downstream_composition.reference_pass_1: existing exact-set semantic/evidence crosscheck machinery or a task-specific reference packet
downstream_composition.reference_pass_2: existing adversarial/control crosscheck machinery or a task-specific reference packet
downstream_composition.synthesis: existing result/review exact-set synthesis authority; firewall records never choose a mathematical winner

nonclaims: A repository record cannot prove that a human or model did not inspect forbidden material outside the governed execution environment.
A valid source pin proves byte identity, not truth of the source.
The source firewall grants no Working Truth, Foundation authority, theorem acceptance, canonical promotion, review authority, or successor authority.
